user.title: Add Islautopia Doorbell
user.description: Enter the doorbell's local IP or hostname (skip this if it already showed up as a discovered device below).

zeroconf_confirm.title: Doorbell found on the network
zeroconf_confirm.description: Found {name} via mDNS. Continue to pair it.

pair.title: Pair with {name}
pair.description: Enter the administrator email and password you already created on the doorbell itself (app or web dashboard, /api/setup). Used once to obtain an access credential - never stored.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the doorbell - check the IP/hostname and that it's on the same network
error.not_a_doorbell: The device responded but doesn't look like an Islautopia Doorbell
error.device_not_paired: The doorbell itself isn't registered with the cloud yet - wait a moment and try again
error.cloud_authorize_failed: The cloud rejected the registration - try again later

abort.no_device_id: The mDNS announcement didn't include a valid device_id

init.title: Re-pair
init.description: Use this if the remote access credential was revoked from the cloud admin panel. Enter the doorbell's administrator email/password again.

error.device_not_paired: The doorbell itself isn't registered with the cloud yet
